findings.fsdQuote: Up to 10 series can be selected from the search results and added together in one step.
findings.note: Add New has no multi-select or batch add; each search result is added individually.

findings.fsdQuote: Deleting a series always deletes its folder and all its files from disk.
findings.note: The delete modal has an optional 'delete files' toggle that defaults to off, plus an option to add an import list exclusion.

findings.fsdQuote: The episode list of a series can be exported as a CSV file.
findings.note: No CSV export exists in the frontend or backend.

findings.fsdQuote: Sonarr can share the calendar as an iCal feed, which covers the previous 14 days and the next 60 days.
findings.note: The iCal feed defaults to the previous 7 days and the next 28 days (pastDays=7, futureDays=28).

findings.fsdQuote: Episodes can be dragged to another day to change their air date.
findings.note: The calendar has no drag-and-drop to change air dates.

findings.fsdQuote: The user can remove a release from the queue. Removing an item from the queue always adds the release to the blocklist.
findings.note: The remove modal lets the user choose: do not blocklist, blocklist and search, or blocklist only.

findings.fsdQuote: Each queue item has a priority (High, Normal or Low) that the user can change to reorder the downloads.
findings.note: The queue UI has no priority control (the only 'priority' hits are column responsiveness).

findings.fsdQuote: Any history entry can be undone, which restores the episode file that an upgrade replaced.
findings.note: History only offers mark as failed on a grab; there is no undo that restores a replaced file.

findings.fsdQuote: Search All starts straight away, without asking the user to confirm.
findings.note: Search All opens a confirmation modal first and only searches after the user confirms.

findings.fsdQuote: A weekly email digest lists every missing episode.
findings.note: No weekly missing-episode email digest exists.

findings.fsdQuote: Tag labels may contain letters, numbers, spaces and underscores.
findings.note: Tag labels must match ^[a-z0-9-]+$, i.e. letters, numbers and hyphens; spaces and underscores are rejected.

findings.fsdQuote: Each tag has a colour, chosen from a palette of 12 colours, which is shown wherever the tag appears.
findings.note: Tags have only a label; there is no colour field or palette.

findings.fsdQuote: The default delay profile can be given tags like any other.
findings.note: The default delay profile (Id 1) must have an empty tag collection; other profiles must have at least one tag.

findings.fsdQuote: Each quality can be limited to a maximum episode runtime.
findings.note: Quality definitions have min/preferred/max size only; there is no runtime limit.

findings.fsdQuote: Each log file can grow up to 50 megabytes before a new one is started.
findings.note: LogSizeLimit is validated between 1 and 10 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Interval: how often an automatic backup is taken, from 1 to 30 days.
findings.note: Backup interval is validated from 1 to 7 days.

findings.fsdQuote: Retention: how long backups are kept, up to 365 days.
findings.note: Backup retention is validated from 1 to 90 days.

findings.fsdQuote: The font size can be set to small, medium or large.
findings.note: The UI settings have no font size option.
The Interface screen has a colour-impaired mode toggle that the FSD does not mention.

findings.fsdQuote: Backups can be copied automatically to an S3 bucket.
findings.note: No S3 backup copy exists.
